content.title: Annual State of the City Address
content.summary: On April 18, 2025, Mayor Lauren Simpson delivered the State of the City address titled “Arvada at Work: Building, Innovating, Thriving,” where she discussed the achievements of 2024 and outlined the city's vision for 2025 and beyond. The event was hosted by the Arvada Chamber of Commerce.
content.body:
On Friday, April 18, 2025, Mayor Lauren Simpson presented the State of the City address. Mayor Simpson’s address was titled “**Arvada at Work: Building, Innovating, Thriving**” and highlighted the successes from 2024 and the vision for 2025 and beyond.

[**View the video of the presentation**](https://youtu.be/lqeBEyVku-I).

Each year, [the Arvada Chamber of Commerce](https://www.arvadachamber.org/) hosts the annual State of the City Address.
